headline: Iraq's PM Office Says Iraq's Security Council Directs Foreign Ministry To Pursue Legal Action Over U.S., Saudi Strikes; Says Only Government Has Authority To Respond To Attacks On Its Territory; Iraq Urges All Parties To Avoid Escalation, Says It Wants To Keep Country Out Of Regional Conflicts
